title: Local detector-mechanism inventory: what is runnable here, under which licence, at what shipping cost

status_vocabulary.AVAILABLE: weights and runtime are both present locally; could be run today without network
status_vocabulary.WEIGHTS_ONLY: weights are cached locally but the runtime is not installed; running it is out of scope for this wave
status_vocabulary.ABSENT: neither the runtime nor the weights are present; obtaining them is a download
status_vocabulary.NOT_MEASURED: no quality and/or cost number exists yet; no number is inferred

shipped_weights_today.role: NER (news domain) — the only token-classification model in the product path
shipped_weights_today.licence_weights: NOT_VERIFIED — distributed inside the MIT wheel; no separate upstream weight-licence statement was located in this wave

shipped_weights_today.role: leased tuning dictionaries (travel in the lease, not the image)
shipped_weights_today.note: identical to B0 RUNTIME.json dictionary hashes

runtime_probe_this_host.note: presence of a library is not a quality claim; nothing here was installed, downloaded or called over the network

candidates.mechanism: rules + gates + Natasha news NER + Natasha address + KV + quasi
candidates.ship_path: already shipped inside the image through the pip dependency; tuning travels in the lease
candidates.resource: NOT_MEASURED by D0; project baseline ~350 MB resident per worker (prototype/pseudex/preflight.py:19,33)
candidates.decision: incumbent, not a candidate to adopt

candidates.mechanism: product path with _ner_spans disabled (still needs Natasha AddrExtractor for the address layer)
candidates.ship_path: does not remove the natasha dependency, so no shipping-weight saving
candidates.resource: NOT_MEASURED (exploratory 5.25 ms/text in the D0 run; not comparable)
candidates.decision: OWNER_PENDING — ablation shows 18/56 golden LOC missed and no difference on the lowercase-speech slice
NOT A CANDIDATE — D0 brief forbids proposing it as a replacement
NOT A MECHANISM — union is not an architecture; added 7 over-masks on the dirty slice

candidates.mechanism: different slovnet model tars (e.g. wiki domain)
candidates.decision: OWNER_PENDING — acquisition (download) is out of scope this wave

candidates.mechanism: fine-tuned Russian token classifier on top of a small Russian encoder
candidates.primary_source: https://huggingface.co/cointegrated/rubert-tiny2 (fetched 2026-09-30, HTTP 200; card states License: mit, Russian)
candidates.gap: pretrained MLM only, no token-classification head; requires fine-tuning, training labels (A1/O-DATA territory) and a separate licence/ship review of the resulting weights
candidates.decision: OWNER_PENDING — new owner decision needed before any training/install

candidates.mechanism: DeBERTa-v3 token classifier fine-tuned on ai4privacy/pii-masking-200k
candidates.primary_source: https://huggingface.co/Isotonic/deberta-v3-base_finetuned_ai4privacy_v2 (fetched 2026-09-30, HTTP 200; card states License: cc-by-nc-4.0, English)
candidates.gap: non-commercial licence and English training data; Russian efficacy NOT_VERIFIED
candidates.decision: NOT SHIPPABLE as-is; research contrast only, and only after legal review

candidates.mechanism: a cached local LLM used as a PII detector
candidates.status: ABSENT in this venv (host has model caches for other runtimes)
candidates.licence: varies per model; NOT_VERIFIED for a detector use
candidates.gap: no token-level calibration, large RSS/latency, per-worker budget impact unknown
candidates.decision: not justified by D0 evidence; only if the owner asks for an LLM-family comparison

candidates.mechanism: sending text to a hosted model
candidates.reason: GOAL-BRIEF P15 and the D0 brief forbid sending PII to external inference

third-party licences are recorded per package
